Explore careers Introducing MV-75 Cheyenne The U.S. Army has officially named the MV-75 Cheyenne, a tribute to the Northern Cheyenne Tribe and the Cheyenne & Arapaho Tribes known for adaptability, endurance and a fierce warrior ethos. The MV-75 Cheyenne reflects these traits as it transforms battlefield geometry and accelerates the Army’s next generation of capability. Read more Outpace. Outperform. Out Maneuver. Taking off at a moment's notice, the MV-75's exceptional range and strategic lift deployment increases operational flexibility and is ready for any mission.
